name: Kurashiki Sayone
source:
Sayone is the protagonist of this story, here are a few things you might want to know about her:

She plays the violin.
She is a member of the math club.
Both of her parents are researchers. Because her father works overseas, she is currently living in an apartment together with her mother.
The thing she likes best is ice cream. She hates scary stories.

[Edited and translated from the [url=http://www.ray-software.net/tokihako/index.html]official website[/url]]
